verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any automatic memory that OpenCode builds and recalls across sessions. Skills are reusable instructions that are discovered from the repo or home directory, not memory the agent builds itself. The project initialization step is described without saying it creates persistent memory. Dynamic Context Pruning is a community-recommended add-on for managing context within long tasks, not cross-session recall.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
